question: In a certain code language, 'DRINK' is written as 'ETLRP', How will 'ABOVE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Number series starting with (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series

So,

 
• 'DRINK' is written as 'ETLRP'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39d35541b67274280018b4574f7514e0932800be52019fe6ec2cb711db59b850.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'ABOVE' will be written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc5fdd41f8c9a7804ccb1c277130c083207a3501f8f5f828fa4054105979c41b.png] 

​Hence, "**BDRZJ**" is the correct answer.
